answers.why: There is no Responses API call anywhere in the pristine source: llmcord.py:260-262 are `response_contents = []` and the `openai_kwargs` dict, and the only LLM call is chat.completions.create at llmcord.py:280 (the 'responses' hits are `use_plain_responses` / `attachment_responses`). Not an LLM call site.

Rule 2: the AsyncOpenAI client (llmcord.py:150-156) takes base_url from config['providers'][provider], where provider is the prefix of curr_model, chosen at runtime (first config key, switchable by admins via /model at llmcord.py:76-85, config re-read per message at :126) from the user-defined providers map in config.yaml:29-59 (openrouter, x-ai, google, azure, lmstudio, ollama, vllm, openai); README:94 says to add your own providers. Ambiguous because the shipped default model openai/gpt-5.5 (config.yaml:62) resolves to https://api.openai.com/v1 with env OPENAI_API_KEY and a catalog id, which alone would be rule 8 migrated.
